about: MCP server URLs as typed, and the URL classify_url (mcp.rs) stores for each. The MCP settings form tells a real URL change from an unchanged one by writing the URL the same way (mcpNormalizedUrl in src/renderer/mcp.js). mcp.rs's tests check classify_url against these cases and scripts/check-assistant-ui.js checks mcpNormalizedUrl, so a url crate that writes one differently fails both until both are changed.
